summary: StudentPREvaluations manages student pre-evaluation records including creation, update, deletion, retrieval, and search functionalities. It interacts with a database through stored procedures and supports multilingual fields.
purpose: To facilitate storage, retrieval, and manipulation of student pre-evaluation data, typically related to placement requests and requirements, with business rules for language and parameter validation.

workflows.name: Add StudentPREvaluation
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, StudentID, PlacementRequestDestinationID, RequirementCodeID, StatusCodeID, EvaluationDate, Comment.

workflows.name: Update StudentPREvaluation
steps: Add parameters: SessionID, ID, RequirementCodeID, StatusCodeID, EvaluationDate, Comment.

workflows.name: Search StudentPREvaluation by ID
steps: If ID is not zero, set stored procedure to 'StudentPREvaluationSearchID'.

workflows.name: Search StudentPREvaluation by StudentID and PRD_ID

business_rules: placementRequestDestinationID must not be zero when adding a new evaluation.
Multilingual fields: Use alt language fields if session specifies.
calculations: EvaluationDateFormatted: If EvaluationDate is null, return empty string. Otherwise, format date short via HSPnet.UI.DateFormatter.
conditions: If session.UseAltLanguageFields is true, fill Requirement and Status from alt fields. Otherwise, use standard fields.
If EvaluationDate is null, EvaluationDateFormatted returns empty.
system_behavior: Uses stored procedures for all database operations.
Supports language-specific fields based on session setting.
Retrieves and fills lists of StudentPREvaluation from database.
dependencies: Stored procedures: StudentPREvaluationAdd, StudentPREvaluationUpdate, StudentPREvaluationDelete, StudentPREvaluationSearchID, StudentPREvaluationSearch
exceptions: No explicit exceptions. Add fails silently if placementRequestDestinationID is zero.
